name: Academy: Live!
source:
The story follows the protagonist as he assumes the role of Principal at the enigmatic ReLive Academy. This new job, however, comes with some expectations placed by the mysterious Board of Directors: they want the new Principal to guide the ladies down a path of corruption, encouraging them to shed their inhibitions and morals.

Will he become the perfect instrument of control for the ever demanding Board, or will he get too close to the girls and choose another approach?

[Edited from itch.io]
